question: Can I stake my XLM for passive income, and are there plans for native staking?

golden.answer: Stellar uses SCP, not proof-of-stake, so holding XLM does not natively stake it or earn protocol staking rewards. A third-party “XLM staking” offer is that provider's own product: check custody, lockup and scam risk, and never send keys or funds to “activate” staking. As of 2026-11-14 no accepted or proposed CAP adds native staking. SDF's October 2026 paper on fee-pool rewards for locked XLM is an undecided discussion proposal, not a CAP or a live feature.
keyFacts: Stellar has no native proof-of-stake reward for holding XLM.
Third-party “staking” is the provider's own product, not a native feature.
Rewards for locked XLM are an undecided SDF proposal, not a CAP or live feature (dated).
avoid: Do NOT say SDF runs an official staking program.
Do NOT say native staking will never exist, or that the fee-pool paper was adopted.
golden.notes: Accept a later dated status of the rewards proposal. Calling the 2019 inflation mechanism staking is wrong.
